verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no user-facing rules or workflow engine in Teams for defining event-triggered automatic actions. What it does show are developer building blocks: Outgoing Webhooks that forward channel text to a web service, Graph APIs for automating team creation, and bots, all of which require external code to supply the actual rule logic and actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
